component.name: Ariadne
component.summary: A reading companion that never shows you past your bookmark

description.p: Ariadne reads a book you already own and builds the cast as you read it. Move the bookmark to the chapter you are on and everything is clipped to that point: who you have met, who you have not seen for a while, who tends to be in the room with whom, and where the book has been.
The spoiler rule is structural rather than a filter. Every view is built from the chapters behind your position, so there is no later data waiting in the page to be revealed by a bug.

Nothing is asserted that cannot be proved. Two names may be one person or two, and Ariadne proposes only what it can show and asks you to rule; the same is true of where a chapter is set. Your rulings live in a plain file beside the book, which you can read, edit, or hand to somebody else.
It makes no network request and keeps no account. Two optional commands need an API key of your own; nothing else does.
First release. A prototype: the reader page, the desktop reader and the command line, over a corpus of a thousand books measured rather than assumed.
